items.text: 'GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.'
items.direction: measured dramatic fantasy narration; perform Rolf as a cordial, official city guide

items.text: 'YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR. THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW,'
items.direction: measured dramatic fantasy narration; perform Rolf as a cordial, official city guide; leave the final clause naturally open

items.text: 'YOU WILL SEE THE ENTRANCE TO THE PASSENGER DOCK AREA WE JUST DEPARTED. FEW SHIPS DARE THE PERILOUS PASSAGE HERE, BUT THE COUNCIL IS DEVELOPING A PLAN TO OPEN UP THE SEA LANES. PLEASE FOLLOW ME.'
items.direction: measured dramatic fantasy narration; perform Rolf as a cordial, official city guide

items.text: 'BEHIND THESE DOORS ARE THE SPECIAL TRAINING SCHOOLS WHERE ADVENTURERS INCREASE THEIR SKILLS. LET US NOW GO TO THE CITY'S MOST IMPORTANT BUILDING.'
items.direction: measured dramatic fantasy narration; perform Rolf as a cordial, official city guide

items.text: 'WE ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THESE WALLS. INSIDE, THE CITY CLERK AWARDS THE COUNCIL'S COMMISSIONS. COMMISSIONS ARE THE QUICKEST WAY TO FAME AND FORTUNE.'
